title: Malformed input rejected
expected_behavior: Unknown schema version or extra field causes explicit input error with no output scores.

title: Integer and currency safety
expected_behavior: Float amount, negative amount or implicit cross-currency aggregate is rejected.

title: Organization collision
expected_behavior: Same account ID in another organization contributes zero features and zero evidence.

title: Duplicate replay
expected_behavior: Identical ID/payload replay changes neither counts nor amount sums.

title: Conflicting duplicate
expected_behavior: Same payment ID with different amount fails validation.

title: Future occurrence
expected_behavior: Later payment is unavailable to an earlier score even if stored in the same file.

title: Late availability
expected_behavior: Earlier occurred event available after scoring is excluded.

title: Equal time
expected_behavior: Equal occurrence-time events use identical pre-batch snapshot.

title: Late label
expected_behavior: Resolved fraud label arriving after training cutoff cannot enter training.

title: Unknown is unknown
expected_behavior: Unresolved labels remain outside binary metric denominator with count shown.

title: Censored evaluation
expected_behavior: Insufficient maturity stops primary result claim and shows coverage.

title: Deterministic generator
expected_behavior: Same seed/config reproduces canonical data hash; changed seed changes hash.

title: No target shortcut
expected_behavior: IDs, row order, metadata and label timestamps are absent from scoring features.

title: Hard legitimate cases
expected_behavior: Payroll burst and new legitimate payee appear in held-out controls with explicit false-alert metrics.

title: Chronology
expected_behavior: Every train/model-selection/calibration/policy/test row meets frozen boundaries and availability cutoffs.

title: Component isolation
expected_behavior: Strict entity experiment has no shared actor/payee/device IDs or cross-split edges.

title: Preprocessing leak trap
expected_behavior: Extreme held-out values cannot change fitted training imputer or scaler.

title: Evaluation prevalence
expected_behavior: Resampling cannot change evaluation row counts or prevalence.

title: Behavior arithmetic
expected_behavior: Hand-calculated prior count, sum, novelty and empty-history indicator match.

title: Graph time trap
expected_behavior: Future common-payee edge cannot affect historical score features.

title: Shared merchant
expected_behavior: Legitimate common merchant motif has no categorical guilt rule.

title: Baseline parity
expected_behavior: All baselines produce one typed result for each same eligible input or explicit error.

title: Equal budget
expected_behavior: Candidate search count and development access do not exceed preregistered baseline budget.

title: Calibration isolation
expected_behavior: Changing test labels cannot change calibrator or probabilities.

title: Score semantics
expected_behavior: Uncalibrated anomaly output is labeled anomaly_score and never probability.

title: Queue capacity
expected_behavior: For N eligible rows with K capacity, exactly min(N,K) rank slots when top-K mode enabled.

title: Stable ties
expected_behavior: Identical risk values sort by the frozen hash tie-break independent of input row order.

title: Evidence integrity
expected_behavior: Every cited event is in same scope and eligible at scoring time; no label evidence appears.

title: Uncertainty language
expected_behavior: New account or missing device returns limited_context and no allegation.

title: AP definition
expected_behavior: Small hand-labeled example matches noninterpolated AP; trapezoidal PR area is separately named if used.

title: Undefined metrics
expected_behavior: Zero-positive slice yields null recall/AP as specified and no fabricated zero success.

title: Alert denominators
expected_behavior: Resolved precision uses selected resolved rows; unresolved selected rows still consume capacity and appear in separate population bounds and counts. Recall uses all resolved positives and distinct population bounds.

title: Amount weighting
expected_behavior: Captured fraud amount divided by eligible fraud amount is separate from transaction recall.

title: Cost formula
expected_behavior: Six-row unknown-capacity-cost fixture yields C_lower 4900 and C_upper 10900 minor units, including the 5000 possible unselected unknown loss.

title: Small subgroup
expected_behavior: Small sample subgroup cannot display conclusive superiority or fairness badge.

title: Shift isolation
expected_behavior: New typology generator parameters do not enter candidate tuning; drift metadata hidden from scorer.

title: Delayed feedback coverage
expected_behavior: Longer feedback delay reduces eligible training labels visibly without altering event truth.

title: Reproduction manifest
expected_behavior: Missing data/model/split hashes causes comparison failure instead of silent aggregation.

title: Review independence
expected_behavior: Human review disposition is a distinct record and cannot mutate original model prediction.

title: Unsafe content
expected_behavior: HTML-like memo text is escaped and cannot execute scripts in report.

title: No external action
expected_behavior: No payment endpoint or network access is invoked by demo or evaluation.

title: Unsafe model payload
expected_behavior: Untrusted serialized executable model is rejected before deserialization.

title: Resource measurement
expected_behavior: Performance report includes hardware, batch size, end-to-end timing, memory and model load time.

title: No invented findings
expected_behavior: Blank result template and pending tasks cannot be presented as measured benchmark.

title: Clean reproduction
expected_behavior: Second environment matches deterministic hashes and disclosed numerical tolerance.

title: Public boundary
expected_behavior: Export contains no private paths, account data, credentials, operational policies or unverified awards.

title: Paired uncertainty
expected_behavior: Primary uncertainty uses identical coherent component draws and clone maps, recomputing each replicate daily N, K, stable ties and both queues; frozen original selected flags are rejected.

title: Failure retention
expected_behavior: Failed seed remains in run manifest and reported failure denominator.

title: Model-selection future label
expected_behavior: A selection-row label arriving after the selection cutoff is excluded and cannot change chosen model.

title: Calibration future label
expected_behavior: A calibration-row label arriving during the final-test period cannot alter the pre-test calibrator.

title: Policy future label
expected_behavior: A policy-row label arriving after policy freeze cannot alter capacity, threshold or cost-based choice.

title: Artifact freeze ordering
expected_behavior: Missing freeze hash or any artifact fitted at or after first final-test score stops evaluation.

title: Stage coverage gate
expected_behavior: Insufficient resolved coverage or class counts prevents supervised choice and returns insufficient_label_coverage; no cutoff movement after test.

title: Unknown capacity bounds
expected_behavior: Four selected rows with one positive, one negative and two unknowns yield resolved precision 1/2 and population precision bounds 1/4 to 3/4.

title: Unselected unknown loss
expected_behavior: Increasing an unselected unknown amount increases cost upper bound by missed_loss_fraction times the increment, without changing lower bound.

title: Bootstrap reranks repeated clusters
expected_behavior: Two coherent copies of component B at a 50 percent rate produce K=2 and select both high-score B rows; copying original queue flags would incorrectly select zero.
